title: Axon: Stunning The Competition - [Business Breakdowns, EP.175]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we are breaking down Axon Enterprise.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we are breaking down Axon Enterprise. You may know Axon as the pioneer of the taser. The business has truly evolved over the years and now has expanded into body cams and other supporting tools for law enforcement and the defense industries.

key_points.text: Our guest is Danielle Menichella, portfolio manager at Sands Capital Management.
Danielle details not just how Axon expanded its product offering but also how it's shifted its business model from pure hardware to a mix of hardware and software..
It's very interesting what unique customer dynamics are driving the growth in certain industries.
